desc: Formalize the boundary representation: define f(y) = number of black cells in column y (nonincreasing in y); derive exact constraints from a B/W cell at (x,y).
Derive the consistency condition and prove the greedy local check is sufficient (monotone sequence with per-column bounds; largest-value greedy is safe).
Implement an O(M log M) checker over constrained columns with per-column lo/hi bounds.
Handle edge cases: N=1, same-column conflicts, i=0/i=N extremes (verified via samples 1–4 reasoning).
Write the final Python solution with fast I/O; verified against the four samples.
